title: Closing or inserting a fact re-points the path:line citations to the lines that shifted, in the ledgers and other articles
goal: factdiff.py close (and any tool that inserts a fact line) maps the lines that shifted and rewrites every path:line citation of that article in _answers.md, _gaps.md, _conflicts.md, _sources.csv and other articles, so citations still name the same fact; found 2026-11-09 when a refresh run re-pointed 24 citations with a scratch diff-based script
